subject: Build script fixes (#307)
reason: The change modifies only build/CI scripts (build.sh, integration/run.sh, and the GitHub Actions workflow) to add a --retries=N option for the project's own integration test runner. No module source code is touched, so the compiled valkey-search module is behaviourally identical at the change and its parent; there is no command, reply, replication, or persistence path for a scenario to reach.
